comparator.name: Notarial Law
comparator.academicYear: Prospective 2027–2028 programme overview, checked against the published 2026–2027 faculty regulations
comparator.route: Notarieel Recht, ordinary three-year bachelor; first-listed third-year metajuridical option
comparator.sourceNotes: The three prospective programme-year pages give 60 EC in each year, totaling 180 EC; they explicitly describe their 2027–2028 offering as provisional. The faculty's 2026–2027 EER applies annually and names the Notarial Law bachelor, but the prospective course list is not represented as an adopted 2026–2027 curriculum. Year one is shared with the other law bachelors. Year two contains all compulsory courses. In year three, 55 EC is compulsory and 5 EC is a restricted choice between paired metajuridical perspectives and research-essay units; the first-listed criminology pair (4+1 EC) is used as a neutral formal instance. The zero-credit Tutoraat is acknowledged but excluded from the credit total. This is the ordinary three-year academic sequence; a part-time registration affects pacing rather than creating additional bachelor content. The bachelor thesis is required at 5 EC. No unrestricted elective credits are implied by the 5-EC restricted option.

components.name: Metajuridische perspectieven: Criminologie
components.note: First-listed permitted metajuridical option, paired with its 1-EC criminology research essay; alternatives are Rechtsfilosofie or Rechtssociologie, each likewise 4+1 EC.

components.name: Academische vaardigheden III: metajuridisch onderzoek criminologie (essay)
components.note: Paired required essay for the selected criminology perspective; not an independent open elective.

routeSelection.route: Notarieel Recht, ordinary three-year bachelor; first-listed third-year metajuridical option
routeSelection.basis: The generic Notarial Law bachelor has a fixed 175-EC compulsory core and one 5-EC restricted third-year choice. The first-listed criminology perspective and its paired essay instantiate that choice without claiming it is mandatory for every student. The full-time three-year presentation avoids treating the separate part-time registration as an academic specialization.

exception.reason: The Notarial Law bachelor is a sustained Dutch-law curriculum: foundational Dutch constitutional and administrative, private, criminal and procedural law leads into civil law I and II, persons and family law, business law, succession and marital property law, private international law for notarial practice, notarial professional ethics and regulation, and multiple Dutch tax subjects. UCR has substantive general and comparative law courses, but no curricular sequence in Dutch civil and notarial law, Dutch family and succession law, Dutch taxation or notarial practice. Even a 24-course selection of UCR law and neighboring courses would omit defining compulsory content and cannot credibly be described as the named Notarial Law degree.
exception.curriculumContext: The university's 2027–2028 prospective year pages specify a complete 180-EC route: 60 EC shared law foundations, 60 EC second-year requirements, and 55 EC third-year requirements plus one paired 5-EC restricted metajuridical option. The pages are explicitly provisional, and the 2026–2027 faculty EER is annual; the prospectus has not been misidentified as binding regulation. The mismatch is substantive rather than an unresolved credit total or the part-time mode.
exception.ucrCourseEvidence: Checked the 151 enriched UCR course rows, including course descriptions and their disciplinary profiles. GOSGATE102 Law, Society & Justice is a broad introduction; GOSLAWJ211 Criminal Law & Criminal Justice treats principles of criminalisation and punishment; GOSLAWJ212 Introduction to Public International Law and GOSLAWJ312 Foundations of European Union Law cover their respective transnational fields; GOSLAWJ213 Comparative Constitutional Law studies constitutions comparatively. GOSLAWJ311 Principles of Private Law compares property, tort and contract law across four countries; BENBUSI311 Transnational Business Law surveys business law across divergent legal systems. GOSLAWJ111 Human Rights: Law & Philosophy covers human rights. These are real thematic overlaps, but none supplies the Dutch private-law sequence, civil procedure, family and succession law, Dutch tax law, notarial professional regulation, or notarial thesis work required by the comparator.
